title: Spring Single-Origin Cupping
description: Join our head roaster for a guided tasting of four new single-origin coffees arriving this spring. Learn to identify flavor notes, discuss processing methods, and discover your palate preferences.

title: Latte Art Fundamentals
description: A hands-on workshop covering milk steaming, free-pour hearts, rosettas, and tulips. All materials provided. Walk away pouring like a pro.

title: Spring Menu Preview Night
description: Be the first to taste our new spring cocktail menu. Our head bartender walks you through the inspiration, ingredients, and techniques behind each creation.

title: Mezcal & Agave Journey
description: Explore the world of agave spirits with our resident agave specialist. Six guided tastings paired with small bites inspired by Oaxacan cuisine.

title: Burgundy vs. Oregon: Pinot Noir Blind Tasting
description: Can you tell Old World from New? Six wines, blind pours, lively debate. Light charcuterie included. No expertise required, just curiosity.

title: Winemaker's Dinner: Domaine Leroy
description: An intimate five-course dinner paired with wines from one of Burgundy's most legendary domaines. The winemaker joins via live video from Vosne-Romanée.

title: Sourdough from Scratch
description: A four-hour immersive workshop where you'll learn to build a starter, mix and shape dough, and bake a beautiful boule. Take home your bread and your new starter.

title: Chef's Table: Spring Foraging Menu
description: An exclusive six-course tasting menu featuring foraged ingredients from our partner farms. Seated at the chef's table with direct kitchen views and commentary.

title: Hudson Valley Farm Day
description: Spend a day at Stone Ridge Farm, our primary produce partner. Tour the fields, meet the farmers, harvest ingredients, and enjoy a farm lunch prepared by our chef.
